Mercedes-Benz Sprinter

2018–2022 · 2.1 diesel · manual · Commercial van

Mercedes-Benz Sprinter
215 ₾ / day

Rates by rental length

  • 3 seats, 14 m³
  • Payload 1,500 kg

When eleven cubic metres runs out, the Sprinter is the next step up: 14 m³ of load volume and a payload of 1,500 kg, enough for a full apartment move or a pallet and a half of stock in a single run. Rear-wheel drive is the right layout for a van that spends its life loaded — traction improves as the weight goes on, rather than the opposite.

Fuel comes in at around 10.5 l/100 km depending on the load, and the manual gearbox suits the long motorway hauls this van is usually booked for: deliveries to Batumi, runs to the port at Poti, exhibition freight.

Two practical points before you book. It is tall, so underground car parks and some courtyard arches are closed to it — check the route if you are loading in central Tbilisi. Cargo must be strapped down, because damage to the load compartment stays with the renter under the standard cover. A corporate contract from one month, with branding permitted, brings the 215 ₾ daily rate down considerably — the schedule is on Prices.
